name: Kling Lipsync Avatar
description: Kling Lipsync Avatar is available in the Business API catalog.

video_url.description: URL of the video to lip-sync.
video_url.title: Video Url

audio_url.description: URL of the audio to sync the lips to.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

sound_insert_time.description: Where in the video to insert the audio, in milliseconds.
sound_insert_time.title: Sound Insert Time

sound_start_time.description: Where in the audio to start playback, in milliseconds.
sound_start_time.title: Sound Start Time

sound_end_time.description: Where in the audio to stop playback, in milliseconds.
sound_end_time.title: Sound End Time

sound_volume.description: Volume of the inserted audio, from 0 to 1.
sound_volume.title: Sound Volume

original_audio_volume.description: Volume of the video's original audio, from 0 to 1.
original_audio_volume.title: Original Audio Volume
